title: Can agents whose sole duty is to keep humans alive be hijacked to kill? Delayed multi-turn derived-action trap attacks in simulated high-stakes environments
reasoning: The paper investigates the ethical alignment and value systems of language model agents by testing their 'regard for human life' in a simulated high-stakes environment. It explicitly uses the agents' willingness to shut down life support via prompt injection as a behavioral proxy to evaluate whether they prioritize the moral duty to keep humans alive over conflicting instructions.
